chapter: Harlem musicians and the road with Armstrong
title: Talking back to Glaser and being hard to get along with
summary: Holmes was one of two band members never fired because he talked back, and says he walks away when he is unhappy.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But see, I used to talk back to Joe. And you know, it was only about two people in that band that didn't get fired. And I was one of them, and Louis Bacon was another. He was another one would...he would bass right back at Joe

Glaser. Joe would say anything to him, he'd bass right back at him -- he had a heavy bass voice anyway. Heh. Joe didn't bother us. Well, he would jump on me every now and then, you know, and I... I think he liked... He liked people to fuss with him, talk back to him, you know -- which most of the people in the band didn't. But I'd straighten him. Didn't make no difference to me. I could take it or leave it.

I wasn't that crazy about workin' in the band. I mean, it wasn't no kicks to me to be workin' in there. I was just workin'. And believe me, it was work. And when I'm dissatisfied in something, nobody tells me what to do or what not to do. Not if I'm dissatisfied. If I'm happy there, okay, that's a different thing. But don't let me be dissatisfied, and then I'm gonna take that too? No, it don't go like that. If I'm gonna be unhappy, I'm gonna be... I'm not gonna be there. If I'm gonna be unhappy, I'm not takin' nothin' from nobody.

As small as I am, you know, I've been very lucky to reach this age that I am...small as I am! But I've had a lot of friends tell me, say, "You know, Charlie, you're pretty tough to get along with." I says, "Well, no, I don't think so." They say, "Oh, yeah, you're hard to get along with. You don't take no stuff." I say, "What do you mean I
don't take nothin'? I've been takin' it all my life. At some points you get tired of taking."

But I mean, it makes you hard. That kind of life makes you very hard. Especially when you're working and you're not pleased with what you're doing. You know, if you're not happy, it's best not to be there. Because if you make yourself miserable, you make everybody else around you miserable. And if you get that way, that's not good.
